title: Projection
description: L1 contract. A Projection is a pure, versioned view computed from a slice of the log (verdandi: what-is-becoming, re-woven from the fixed past). Projections are read-time artifacts, not ground truth — they may be wrong, re-derived, or rolled back by re-projecting an older version, and none of that touches urd. project(log_slice) must be a pure function: same source_event_ids in, same data out.

projection_id.description: Unique identifier for this projection instance.

view_name.description: Which kind of view this is, e.g. 'supersession_chain', 'entity_graph', 'session_summary'. Multiple views may coexist over the same log slice.

version.description: Monotonically increasing version for this view_name. Migration is re-projection to a new version; rollback is re-projection using the old projection logic, never mutation of an old version.

source_event_ids.description: The exact set of log event_ids this projection was computed from, so the projection is reproducible and auditable back to ground truth.

quality_score.description: Fed back retroactively by L5 (skuld) from verification outcomes that relied on this projection. Null until at least one outcome has scored it.

data.description: The view content itself. Structure is view_name-specific.
